mil7.4.2:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, āpassa pañca angāni gahetabbāniti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni pañca angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.4.2:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena kuhana-lapana-nemittaka-nippesikataṃ apanetvā susaṇṭhita-m-akampita-m aluḷita-sabhāvaparisuddhācārena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.2:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja āpassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.2:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja āpo sītalasabhāvasaṇṭhito,
mil7.4.2:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sabbasattesu khanti-mettā- 'nuddaya-sampannena hitesinā anukampakena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.2:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja āpassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.2:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja āpo asuciṃ suciṃ karoti,
mil7.4.2:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena gāme vā araññe vā upajjhāye ācariye ācariyamattesu sabbattha anadhikaraṇena bhavitabbaṃ anavakāsakārinā.
mil7.4.2:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja āpassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.2:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja āpo bahujanapatthito,
mil7.4.2:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena appiccha-santuṭṭha-pavivitta-paṭisallāṇena satataṃ sabbalokamabhipatthitena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.2:4.3: Idaṃ mahārāja āpassa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.2:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja āpo na kassaci ahitam-upadahati,
mil7.4.2:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena parabhaṇḍana-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-rittajjhāna-arati-jananaṃ kāya-vacī-cittehi pāpakaṃ na karaṇīyaṃ.
mil7.4.2:5.3: Idaṃ mahārāja āpassa pañcamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.2:5.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Kaṇhajātake:
